name: Klein Karoo
full: Klein Karoo — the remainder beyond Calitzdorp
terroir: The Klein Karoo's remaining ground runs the length of Route 62 from Montagu through Barrydale to Oudtshoorn, De Rust and Herold — a hot, dry, semi-desert interior known historically for fortified wines, potstill brandy and Muscadel/Jerepigo dessert styles as much as for table wine.
lede: The Klein Karoo's remaining ground runs the length of Route 62 from Montagu through Barrydale to Oudtshoorn, De Rust and Herold — a hot, dry, semi-desert interior known historically for fortified wines, potstill brandy and Muscadel/Jerepigo dessert styles as much as for table wine.
